title: Mesh2Motion
credit: Mesh2Motion's human animations (mesh2motion.org, CC0 1.0): Quaternius' Universal Animation Library clips as Mesh2Motion re-exported them, clips its contributors animated, and its own motion captures. Each clip's src names which, and orig the Quaternius clip a re-export was made from.
legend: Readable key poses (the my-3D2dge format). Times in seconds; every other number is a whole number. Rig frame: forward, right, up.
L and R are the figure's own sides. Directions are percentages and need not add up: [100, 0, 0] and [50, 0, 0] agree.
hips   [forward, right, up]   the pelvis, in percent of standing hip height (100 = standing, 55 = sitting on a chair)
body   [turn, lean, tilt]     the pelvis, degrees: turn + = toward the right, lean + = forward, tilt + = toward the right
chest  [turn, lean, tilt]     the chest, relative to the pelvis; head [turn, lean, tilt] relative to the chest
shL shR    [reach, shrug]     degrees the shoulder swings forward (into a punch or an aim) and up, from rest

armL armR  [forward, out, up, bend, twist]  which way the arm points from the shoulder to the fist, in chest space (out + = away from the body on that side; [0, 0, -100] hangs down, [100, 0, 0] punches ahead); bend = elbow bend in degrees (0 = straight); twist = degrees the elbow swings round the arm from its natural direction (back and down)
legL legR  [forward, out, up, bend, twist]  hip to ankle in pelvis space; bend: the knee; twist: from pointing forward
footL footR [down, out, toes]   degrees the foot points down from standing, turns outward, and the toes bend up
blade  [forward, right, up]   (sword clips) the direction of a blade held in the right fist, in chest space
root   [forward, right]       (clips that travel) how far the whole body has moved, in percent of standing hip height

M2M_ANIMATED.label: Mesh2Motion, hand-animated
M2M_ANIMATED.origin: Animated in Blender by Mesh2Motion's contributors on its human rig (human-addon-animations.glb; the Blender sources are in Mesh2Motion/mesh2motion-assets, rigs/human)

M2M_MOCOPI.label: Mesh2Motion, motion capture
M2M_MOCOPI.origin: Captured by Mesh2Motion with a Sony mocopi suit and retargeted onto its human rig with its own Blender add-on (human-mocap-animations.glb; the raw BVH captures are in Mesh2Motion/mesh2motion-assets, motion-capture)

M2M_QUATERNIUS.label: Quaternius, via Mesh2Motion
M2M_QUATERNIUS.origin: Quaternius' Universal Animation Library 1 and 2 as Mesh2Motion re-exported them on its human rig (human-base-animations.glb). Library 1's clips run 25% longer than in Quaternius' own files, and a few are trimmed or end back on their feet. Each clip's orig names the Quaternius clip it was made from

Angry.desc: an angry outburst: flings both arms out wide and down, twice

Attack_Ground_Pound.desc: crouches, springs up with the arms spread, and slams down into a low crouch

Backflip.desc: crouches, springs into a full backward somersault, lands crouched and stands

Bow.desc: raises a bow from low to aim at head height, holds the aim, lowers it

Bow Pull Back.desc: raises a bow, nocks and draws the string back to the face

Bow Pull Hold.desc: holds a bow at full draw, aiming

Bow Release.desc: looses the arrow: the drawing hand springs back, the bow arm held out

Cheer_One_arm.desc: cheers with one fist raised high

Cheering_Two_Hands.desc: cheers with both arms raised overhead, waving

Chest_Open.desc: bends forward and lifts a chest's lid with both hands, then straightens

Chop_Tree.desc: chops with an axe: swings from over the shoulder down into a tree

Climb Ladder.desc: climbs a ladder hand over hand, in place

Climb Wall.desc: climbs a sheer wall, reaching high hand over hand and stepping up, in place

ClimbUp_1m_RM.desc: grabs a ledge about 1 m high and hauls up onto it (travels)

Confused.desc: scratches the head and looks about, puzzled

Consume.desc: eats or drinks: lifts the left hand to the mouth, tips the head, lowers it

Consume Item.desc: brings an item up to the mouth with both hands and eats, then lowers it

Crawl.desc: crawls on the belly, reaching ahead with alternate arms, in place

Crawl RM.desc: crawls on the belly, reaching ahead with alternate arms (travels)

Crouch_Idle.desc: crouched low and still, looking about

Dance Body Roll.desc: a long dance: body rolls, arm waves and a dip, 6.5 seconds

Dance Charleston.desc: the Charleston: the knees swing in and out, the hands cross over them

Dance Reach Hip.desc: a dance: hip pops, then one arm reaching high and pointing out

Dance_Simple.desc: a one-second groove: hips sway, arms swing out

Death_A.desc: clutches the chest, staggers and sinks down onto the side, and lies still

Death_B.desc: thrown back off the feet into the air and lands flat on the ground

Death_C.desc: falls straight back, rolls over and lies spread out

Death_D.desc: staggers back, the knees buckle, and falls onto the side, then lies flat

Defend.desc: crouched behind raised forearms, guarding the head

Dizzy.desc: sways in place, unsteady, the head lolling

Dodge_back.desc: hops back a step out of the way of a blow, in place

Dodge_back_RM.desc: hops back a step out of the way of a blow (travels)

Dodge_left.desc: throws the body to the left in a low lunge and recovers, in place

Dodge_left_RM.desc: throws the body to the left in a low lunge and recovers (travels)

Dodge_right.desc: throws the body to the right in a low lunge and recovers, in place

Dodge_right_RM.desc: throws the body to the right in a low lunge and recovers (travels)

Driving.desc: seated, hands on a steering wheel, small turns

Farm_Harvest.desc: bends down and pulls a crop up out of the ground

Farm_PlantSeed.desc: kneels, presses a seed into the soil, stands

Farm_Watering.desc: tips a watering can held in the right hand, sweeping it over the ground

Fighting Idle.desc: a boxer's stance: fists up, bouncing lightly

Fighting Left Jab.desc: from the fighting stance, swings the left fist out wide and back to guard

Fighting Right Jab.desc: from the fighting stance, a straight right punch and back to guard

Fishing_Cast.desc: swings a fishing rod back over the shoulder and casts it forward

Fishing_Catch.desc: jerks the rod up to hook a fish and pulls it in

Fishing_Reel.desc: holds the rod out and turns the reel

Fixing_Kneeling.desc: kneels on one knee and works with both hands near the ground

Flying Forward.desc: flying forward, body level, arms at the sides, legs trailing

Flying Forward Super.desc: flying forward like a superhero, both arms stretched ahead

Glide.desc: gliding: the body leaning forward, both arms raised overhead in a V

Golf_Drive.desc: addresses the ball and swings a golf club through

Golf_idle.desc: stands over a golf ball, the club held low, shifting weight

Greeting.desc: lays the right hand on the chest and bows the head in greeting

Help_One_Arm.desc: waves one arm overhead for attention: help

Help_Two_Arms.desc: waves both arms overhead for attention

Hit_Chest.desc: a slight flinch: the shoulders jolt and the arms swing a little; the body barely moves

Hit_Head.desc: takes a blow to the head: head snaps aside, recovers

Idle_FoldArms.desc: standing with the arms folded across the chest, shifting weight: waiting, listening

Idle_Shield.desc: guarding: the left forearm held across the chest behind a shield

Idle_Sword.desc: standing ready with a sword in the right hand

Idle_Talking.desc: standing and talking with hand gestures

Idle_TalkingPhone.desc: on the phone: right hand at the ear, left arm across the body

Idle_Torch.desc: standing with one arm raised, holding up a torch or lantern

Jump_2_RM.desc: crouches and jumps up and forward with the arms flung forward, then lands (travels)

Jump_Land.desc: lands from a fall, knees soak it up, stands

Jump_Start.desc: dips, then springs up with the arms thrown out (in place: the game lifts the body)

Jumping Jacks.desc: jumping jacks: the arms and legs scissor out and in

Push.desc: leans in and shoves something heavy, stepping

Pushup.desc: push-ups: the body held straight, arms bending and pressing up

Roll.desc: forward roll over the shoulder and back to standing, in place

Run_Anime.desc: an anime ninja run: body pitched forward, arms trailing straight back (travels)

Run_Female.desc: a light run with swinging arms, in place

Salute.desc: stands at attention, salutes and lowers the hand

Shield_OneShot.desc: a quick block: snaps the shield arm up across the chest, then lowers it

Shivering.desc: hunched with the arms hugged in, shivering with cold

Sitting_Enter.desc: sits down onto a seat (no chair is drawn)

Slide.desc: sliding feet first, leaning back on one hand

Spell_Simple_Enter.desc: raises a hand to ready a spell

Sword_Attack_Air_Vertical.desc: leaps and chops down with a two-handed overhead swing, landing crouched
